title: fix: modified files with umlauts
summary: Incremental build detection now finds project and app paths that contain umlauts or other special characters such as ß. It does this by turning off git path escaping and switching to UTF-8 output encoding while git diff runs.
key_points: git diff now runs with -c core.quotepath=false, so special characters are no longer escaped as byte sequences
The console encoding is set to UTF-8 before the git command and restored afterwards
Fixes incremental builds that missed modified projects or apps whose paths contain characters like ä, ö, ü or ß
Unit tests added for DetermineProjectsToBuild, and release notes updated
